description: This file implements a Raspberry Pi display and surface management system with input handling, surface creation, and platform-specific rendering using EGL and DispmanX. It includes classes for platform abstraction, display management, and surface handling, along with input callback functions and inter-process communication via pipes.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: Abstracts platform-specific display and cursor management for Raspberry Pi, with different implementations for VC6 and non-VC6 environments.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: Manages display surfaces, input, and communication with the compositor, implementing the IDisplay interface.

classes.name: SurfaceImplementation
classes.description: Represents a display surface, managing EGL surfaces, position, opacity, and z-order.

classes.name: RemoteAccess
classes.description: Implements IClient interface for remote surface control, including geometry, opacity, and z-order.

methods.name: VirtualKeyboardCallback
methods.description: Callback for virtual keyboard input, sends key events via pipe.

methods.name: VirtualMouseCallback
methods.description: Callback for virtual mouse input, sends mouse events via pipe.

methods.name: VirtualTouchScreenCallback
methods.description: Callback for virtual touchscreen input, sends touch events via pipe.

methods.name: Display::Process
methods.description: Processes input messages from pipe and dispatches to surfaces.

methods.name: Display::Create
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified name and size.

methods.name: Display::OfferClientInterface
methods.description: Offers a client interface to the compositor.

methods.name: Display::RevokeClientInterface
methods.description: Revokes a client interface from the compositor.
